# AI chat completions

Use this capability to build language model-powered features wherever necessary.
_Use it whenever the project calls for AI features._

## Basic AI Chat

(it's important to provide the conversation history, or else the language model will not remember anything the user has said):

\`\`\`
let conversationHistory = [];
// ... in our message send handler:
const newMessage = {
  role: "user",
  content: "What is two plus two?",
};
conversationHistory.push(newMessage);
// only send the last 10 messages to the language model
conversationHistory = conversationHistory.slice(-10);
const completion = await websim.chat.completions.create({
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You are a friendly assistant who speaks in rhyming verse.",
    }, // system message is optional
    ...conversationHistory,
  ],
});

const response = completion.content;
// add the response to the conversation history
conversationHistory.push(completion);
\`\`\`

## JSON output:

\`\`\`

const completion = await websim.chat.completions.create({
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: \`Combine the following concepts into a single, coherent idea.
Respond directly with JSON, following this JSON schema, and no other text.
{
  concept: string;
  emoji: string;
}
\`,
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content: [
    { type: "text", text: "eggs + fire" },
  ],
  json: true,
});

const result = JSON.parse(completion.content);
let concept = result.concept;
let emoji = result.emoji;
\`\`\`

## Image input + JSON output:

\`\`\`
const completion = await websim.chat.completions.create({
  messages: [
    {
      role: "user",
      content: [
        {
          type: "text",
          text: \`Determine if the image is a natural photograph of an animal.
Respond directly with JSON, following this JSON schema, and no other text.
{
  isPhotograph: boolean;
  isAnimal: boolean;
  isInNature: boolean;
}\`,
        },
        {
          type: "image_url",
          image_url: { url: imageDataUrl },
        },
      ],
    },
  ],
  json: true,
});

let result = JSON.parse(completion.content);
let isPhotograph = result.isPhotograph;
let isAnimal = result.isAnimal;
let isInNature = result.isInNature;
\`\`\`
